rows.label: Evel Knievel
rows.hook: became famous for daring ramp jumps over rows of buses and the Caesars Palace fountains

rows.label: Bam Margera
rows.hook: rose to fame on a stunt-and-prank TV series and its movie spin-offs

rows.label: Alex Honnold
rows.description: American professional mountaineer and extreme climber
rows.hook: climbed the face of El Capitan without ropes, as shown in an Oscar-winning documentary

rows.label: Felix Baumgartner
rows.description: Austrian skydiver, daredevil and BASE jumper (1969–2025)
rows.hook: jumped from a balloon at the edge of space and broke the sound barrier in freefall

rows.label: Tony Hawk
rows.hook: landed the first 900 in competition and lends his name to a hit video game series

rows.label: Chloe Kim
rows.hook: became an Olympic halfpipe champion as a teenager and then defended the title

rows.label: Dave Mirra
rows.hook: won a record haul of X Games medals on two wheels and starred in a video game

rows.label: Bethany Hamilton
rows.hook: returned to competition after a shark attack cost her an arm, inspiring a movie

rows.label: Travis Pastrana
rows.description: American professional motorsports competitor and stunt performer
rows.hook: landed the first double backflip on a dirt bike and leads the Nitro Circus stunt crew

rows.label: Rob Dyrdek
rows.hook: hosted a reality show set in his wild workplace called Fantasy Factory

rows.label: Shaun White
rows.hook: won multiple Olympic halfpipe golds and is nicknamed the Flying Tomato

rows.label: Kelly Slater
rows.hook: won a record number of world titles and helped design an artificial wave pool

rows.label: Rodney Mullen
rows.hook: invented the flatground ollie and other tricks that define modern street style

rows.label: Laird Hamilton
rows.hook: pioneered tow-in big-wave riding and helped spark the stand-up paddleboard craze
